questions.question: A person observes an object on the ground from the top of a tower at an angle of depression 60°. If the distance between the foot of the tower and the object is 10sqrt{3} m, then find the height (in m) of the tower.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a 30°-60°-90° right-angled triangle, the ratio of the sides opposite to the angles is 1 : √3 : 2.

The angle of elevation is equal to the angle of depression (60°).

The side opposite to 30° (base distance) is 10√3 m.

The side opposite to 60° (tower height) will be √3 times the base.

Height = 10√3 × √3 = 30 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 30 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 
• 
 60° 
 60° A B C h 10√3 m 

**Given:**

Angle of depression from the top of the tower = 60°

Distance of the object from the foot of the tower (BC) = 10√3 m

Let the height of the tower be 'h' meters.

**Formula Used:**

tan(θ) = Perpendicular ÷ Base

**Calculations:**

⇒ The horizontal line of sight is parallel to the ground.

⇒ Therefore, alternate interior angles are equal, making the angle of elevation (∠C) = 60°.

⇒ In right-angled ΔABC,

⇒ tan(60°) = AB ÷ BC

⇒ √3 = h ÷ 10√3

⇒ h = 10√3 × √3

⇒ h = 10 × 3

⇒ h = 30 m

**∴ The correct answer is 30 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle of Elevation and Depression

Angle of elevation is measured upwards from the horizontal line of sight, while angle of depression is measured downwards. They form a pair of alternate interior angles and are always equal in magnitude.

Important Trigonometric Ratios

For standard right triangles in height and distance problems, memorize: tan(30°) = 1/√3, tan(45°) = 1, and tan(60°) = √3.

30°-60°-90° Triangle Theorem

The sides opposite the angles of 30°, 60°, and 90° follow a fixed ratio of x : x√3 : 2x respectively. This helps solve geometry questions directly without using trigonometric formulas.

questions.question: In an election held in a city, the voting percentage was 72%. The winner got 27% of the polled votes, while the runner-up got 15% of the polled votes. If there were 1,20,000 voters in that city, by how many votes did the winner win the election?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

First find polled votes

72% of 120000 = 86400

Difference in votes = (27% − 15%) = 12% of polled votes

= 12% of 86400

= 10368

**∴ Answer = 10368 votes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total voters = 120000, Voting % = 72%

Winner = 27% of polled votes, Runner-up = 15%

**Formula used:**

Votes = Percentage × Total

**Calculation:**

⇒ Polled votes = 120000 × 72/100 = 86400

⇒ Winner votes = 27% of 86400 = 23328

⇒ Runner-up votes = 15% of 86400 = 12960

⇒ Difference = 23328 − 12960 = 10368

**∴ The correct answer is 10368 votes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Voting Percentage

Polled votes = Total voters × voting percentage.

Difference Shortcut

Difference = (difference in %) × total base directly.

Percentage Handling

Convert percentages into fractions for faster calculation.

questions.question: The average of the first 9 even natural numbers is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The average of the first 'n' even natural numbers is directly given by (n + 1).

Here, the number of terms n = 9.

Average = 9 + 1 = 10.

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The first 9 even natural numbers are: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of observations ÷ Total number of observations

Sum of first n even natural numbers = n × (n + 1)

 
• 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 2
 4
 6
 8
 10
 12
 14
 16
 18

 

 Symmetrical AP Series
 
 Middle Term = Average
 
• 
 

 Average = (First + Last) ÷ 2 = (2 + 18) ÷ 2 = 10

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total number of observations (n) = 9

⇒ Sum of the 9 even numbers = 9 × (9 + 1) = 9 × 10 = 90

⇒ Average = 90 ÷ 9 = 10

Alternatively, the numbers form an Arithmetic Progression.

⇒ Average of an AP = (First Term + Last Term) ÷ 2

⇒ Average = (2 + 18) ÷ 2 = 20 ÷ 2 = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average of First n Natural Numbers

The average of the first n natural numbers is calculated as (n + 1) ÷ 2.

Average of First n Odd Numbers

The average of the first n odd natural numbers is exactly equal to n.

Average of an Arithmetic Progression

For any sequence in an arithmetic progression, the average is simply the middle term or (First Term + Last Term) ÷ 2.

Sum of First n Even Numbers

The sum of the first n even natural numbers is given by n × (n + 1).
</p

questions.question: If the number of sides of a regular polygon is 18, then what is the measure of the interior angle of the polygon?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any regular polygon, the sum of an interior angle and its corresponding exterior angle is always 180°.

Exterior angle = 360° ÷ number of sides

⇒ Exterior angle = 360° ÷ 18 = 20°

⇒ Interior angle = 180° − 20° = 160°

**∴ The correct answer is 160°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of sides of the regular polygon (n) = 18

**Formula Used:**

Measure of each interior angle of a regular polygon = (n − 2) × 180° ÷ n

questions.question: Nisha goes to a shop to purchase a toy drum priced at ₹5,000. She is offered 4 discount options by the shopkeeper. Which of the following options should she opt for to gain maximum advantage of the discount offered?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert all into equivalent discount

1) 23% & 23% ⇒ 23 + 23 − (23 × 23)/100 = 46 − 5.29 = 40.71%

2) Single discount = 64%

3) 7% & 45% ⇒ 7 + 45 − (7 × 45)/100 = 52 − 3.15 = 48.85%

4) 10% & 39% ⇒ 10 + 39 − (10 × 39)/100 = 49 − 3.9 = 45.1%

Maximum discount is 64%

**∴ Answer = Option 2 (64% discount)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked price = 5000 and four discount options

**Formula used:**

Successive discount = a + b − (ab/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Option 1: Net discount = 23 + 23 − (23 × 23)/100 = 40.71%

⇒ Option 2: Net discount = 64%

⇒ Option 3: Net discount = 7 + 45 − (7 × 45)/100 = 48.85%

⇒ Option 4: Net discount = 10 + 39 − (10 × 39)/100 = 45.1%

⇒ Maximum discount = 64%

**∴ The correct answer is Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

Net discount = a + b − (ab/100)

Comparison Rule

Higher effective discount gives maximum benefit.

Important Insight

Single large discount can sometimes exceed multiple smaller discounts.

questions.question: P sells an item to R at a profit of 10%, and R sells it to Q at a profit of 5%. What would have been P's profit percentage if he had sold the item directly to Q at the price R sold it?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let CP = 100

P → R at 10% ⇒ price = 110

R → Q at 5% ⇒ price = 110 × 1.05 = 115.5

Direct selling price = 115.5

Profit = 115.5 − 100 = 15.5%

**∴ Answer = 15.5%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

P sells to R at 10% profit, R sells to Q at 5% profit

**Formula used:**

SP = CP × (1 + profit/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let cost price of P = 100

⇒ Selling price to R = 100 × 1.10 = 110

⇒ R sells to Q = 110 × 1.05 = 115.5

⇒ If P sold directly to Q, SP = 115.5

⇒ Profit = 115.5 − 100 = 15.5

⇒ Profit% = 15.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 15.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Profit

Overall multiplier = (1 + a/100)(1 + b/100)

Combined Profit

Net profit% = a + b + (ab/100)

Shortcut Insight

Use multiplication of factors instead of step-by-step calculation.

questions.question: A taxi service charges a fixed base fare plus a variable rate per kilometre. For a 10 km trip, Raju paid ₹230, and for a 15 km trip, Meena paid ₹330. What is the base fare and the per-kilometre charge?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference method to eliminate base fare

15 km − 10 km = 5 km ⇒ extra cost = 330 − 230 = 100

Per km charge = 100 ÷ 5 = 20

Base fare = 230 − (10 × 20) = 30

**∴ Answer = Base fare = ₹30, Rate = ₹20/km**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

10 km → ₹230 and 15 km → ₹330

**Formula used:**

Total fare = Base fare + (Rate × distance)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let base fare = B and rate = r

⇒ B + 10r = 230

⇒ B + 15r = 330

⇒ Subtract equations ⇒ 5r = 100

⇒ r = 20

⇒ B + 10 × 20 = 230

⇒ B = 30

**∴ The correct answer is Base fare = ₹30 and Rate = ₹20/km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Linear Equation Concept

Problems with fixed + variable cost form linear equations.

Elimination Method

Subtract equations to remove constant term quickly.

Real-Life Application

Used in taxi fares, utility billing, and pricing models.

questions.question: If the radius of a sphere is 22 cm, then its surface area is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The surface area of a sphere can be calculated directly by substituting the given radius into the standard formula.

Surface Area = 4 × π × r²

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × (22)²

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × 484 × π = 1936π

**∴ The correct answer is 1936π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 
• 
 
 r = 22 cm
 Sphere Surface Area = 4πr²

**Given:**

Radius of the sphere (r) = 22 cm

**Formula Used:**

Surface Area of a sphere = 4πr²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × (22)²

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × 484

⇒ Surface Area = 1936π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1936π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Sphere

The volume represents the total space occupied by the sphere and is calculated using the formula: Volume = (4 ÷ 3) × π × r³.

Curved Surface Area of a Hemisphere

A hemisphere is half of a sphere. Its curved surface area (CSA) does not include the circular flat base: CSA = 2πr².

Total Surface Area of a Hemisphere

The total surface area of a hemisphere includes both the curved surface and the flat circular base: TSA = 3πr².

questions.question: Three candidates contested an election. The first candidate got 40% votes and the second got 30% votes. If the total number of votes polled were 36,000, find the number of votes obtained by the third candidate.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total % = 100 ⇒ Third candidate = 100 − (40 + 30) = 30%

Votes = 30% of 36000

= 0.30 × 36000

= 10800

**∴ Answer = 10800**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total votes = 36000

First candidate = 40%, Second candidate = 30%

**Formula used:**

Votes = Percentage × Total votes

**Calculation:**

⇒ Votes of first = 40% of 36000 = 14400

⇒ Votes of second = 30% of 36000 = 10800

⇒ Remaining votes = 36000 − (14400 + 10800)

⇒ Remaining = 36000 − 25200 = 10800

**∴ The correct answer is 10800.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Complementary Percentage

If parts are known, remaining % = 100 − sum of known percentages.

Quick Calculation

Directly use remaining percentage instead of finding each part.

Percentage Conversion

Convert percentage to decimal or fraction for fast multiplication.

questions.question: If the mean proportional of A and 27 is 18, then find the value of A.5768
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mean proportional between two numbers X and Y is given by √(X × Y).

⇒ 18 = √(A × 27)

Squaring both sides:

⇒ 324 = A × 27

⇒ A = 324 ÷ 27 = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First number = A

Second number = 27

Mean proportional = 18

**Formula Used:**

If b is the mean proportional between a and c, then they are in continuous proportion a : b :: b : c.

Product of extremes = Product of means ⇒ a × c = b²

 
 A
 :
 18
 ::
 18
 :
 27

 

 Product of Extremes = A × 27

 

 Product of Means = 18 × 18

**Calculations:**

⇒ Product of Extremes = Product of Means

⇒ A × 27 = 18 × 18

⇒ 27A = 324

⇒ A = 324 ÷ 27

⇒ A = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Third Proportional

If c is the third proportional to a and b, then a : b :: b : c, which gives the relation c = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportional

If d is the fourth proportional to a, b, and c, then a : b :: c : d, which establishes the relation a × d = b × c.

Duplicate Ratio

The duplicate ratio of a : b is defined as a² : b², while their sub-duplicate ratio is expressed as √a : √b.
</p

questions.question: Two trains, A and B, of lengths 457 m and 113 m are running at speeds of 18 m/s and 20 m/s, respectively, towards each other on parallel tracks. In how much time will they cross each other?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance covered = Sum of lengths of trains = 457 + 113 = 570 m

Since trains are moving in opposite directions, relative speed is the sum of their speeds.

Relative speed = 18 + 20 = 38 m/s

Time taken = Distance ÷ Speed = 570 ÷ 38 = 15 s

**∴ The correct answer is 15 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of Train A = 457 m

Speed of Train A = 18 m/s

Length of Train B = 113 m

Speed of Train B = 20 m/s

**Formula Used:**

Time = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed

questions.question: Find the smallest number which when increased by 20 is completely divisible by 12, 20, 15, 18 and 24.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The smallest number divisible by the given numbers is their LCM.

LCM of 12, 15, 18, 20 and 24 = 360

According to the question, the required number must be increased by 20 to become exactly divisible.

Required number = LCM − 20 = 360 − 20 = 340.

**∴ The correct answer is 340.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Divisors are 12, 15, 18, 20 and 24.

The smallest number when increased by 20 is exactly divisible by these divisors.

**Concept Used:**

Required number = LCM(a, b, c...) − increase.

**Calculations:**

Prime factorisation of the given numbers:

⇒ 12 = 2² × 3

⇒ 15 = 3 × 5

⇒ 18 = 2 × 3²

⇒ 20 = 2² × 5

⇒ 24 = 2³ × 3

Highest powers of prime factors are 2³, 3² and 5.

⇒ LCM = 2³ × 3² × 5

⇒ LCM = 8 × 9 × 5 = 360

This means 360 is the smallest number completely divisible by all the given numbers.

As the required number is increased by 20 to become 360:

⇒ Required number + 20 = 360

⇒ Required number = 360 − 20 = 340

**∴ The correct answer is 340.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Least Common Multiple (LCM)

The smallest positive integer that is a multiple of two or more numbers. It is found by multiplying the highest powers of all prime factors present in the numbers.

Highest Common Factor (HCF)

The largest positive integer that divides two or more numbers without leaving a remainder. It is the product of the lowest powers of common prime factors.

LCM and HCF Formula

For any two numbers a and b, the product of the numbers is equal to the product of their HCF and LCM: LCM(a, b) × HCF(a, b) = a × b.

Case of Constant Remainder

To find the smallest number which leaves a constant remainder R when divided by a, b, and c, use the formula: Required Number = LCM(a, b, c) + R.
</p

questions.question: Simplify: (10 times a⁵ times b⁶)/(2 times a² times b³)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Divide the numerical coefficients and subtract the exponents of matching variables directly.

Numbers: 10 ÷ 2 = 5

Exponents of a: 5 − 2 = 3 ⇒ a³

Exponents of b: 6 − 3 = 3 ⇒ b³

Combining all parts gives 5 a³ b³.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 a³ b³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: (10 × a⁵ × b⁶) ÷ (2 × a² × b³)

**Formula Used:**

Law of Exponents for division: xm ÷ xⁿ = xm−ⁿ

**Calculation:**

⇒ Separate the constants and variables:

⇒ (10 ÷ 2) × (a⁵ ÷ a²) × (b⁶ ÷ b³)

⇒ Apply the division law of exponents by subtracting the denominator powers from the numerator powers:

⇒ 5 × a⁵−² × b⁶−³

⇒ 5 × a³ × b³

⇒ 5 a³ b³

**∴ The correct answer is 5 a³ b³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Laws of Exponents (Multiplication)

When multiplying terms with the same base, add their exponents: am × aⁿ = am⁺ⁿ

Power of a Power Rule

When raising a power to another power, multiply the exponents: (am)ⁿ = am×ⁿ

Negative Exponents

A negative exponent indicates the reciprocal of the base raised to a positive power: a−ⁿ = 1 / aⁿ

Zero Exponent Rule

Any non-zero base raised to the power of zero is always equal to one: a⁰ = 1

questions.question:
The capacity of a cylindrical vessel is 25.872 litres. If the height of the cylinder is three times the radius of its base, then what is the curved surface area of the cylinder?

 (Use pi = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert volume: 25.872 L = 25872 cm³

Given h = 3r ⇒ Volume = πr²h = 3πr³

25872 = 3πr³ ⇒ r³ = 25872 ÷ (66/7) = 2744

r = 14 cm ⇒ h = 42 cm

CSA = 2πrh = 2 × (22/7) × 14 × 42 = 3696 cm²

**∴ Answer = 3696 cm²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volume = 25.872 litres = 25872 cm³, h = 3r

**Formula used:**

Volume = πr²h and CSA = 2πrh

**Calculation:**

⇒ Volume = πr²(3r) = 3πr³

⇒ 25872 = 3 × (22/7) × r³

⇒ 25872 = (66/7)r³

⇒ r³ = 25872 × 7 ÷ 66 = 2744

⇒ r = 14 cm

⇒ h = 3r = 42 cm

⇒ CSA = 2πrh = 2 × (22/7) × 14 × 42

⇒ CSA = 3696 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 3696 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Cylinder

Volume = πr²h

Curved Surface Area

CSA = 2πrh

Unit Conversion

1 litre = 1000 cm³, always convert before calculation.

questions.question: The salaries of X, Y and Z are in the ratio 18:5:10. If the increments of 45%, 86% and 89% are allowed, respectively, in their salaries, then what will be new ratio of their salaries?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply multiplier to each ratio term

New ratio = 18 × 1.45 : 5 × 1.86 : 10 × 1.89

= 26.1 : 9.3 : 18.9

Multiply by 10 ⇒ 261 : 93 : 189

Simplify by 3 ⇒ 87 : 31 : 63

**∴ Answer = 87 : 31 : 63**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial ratio = 18 : 5 : 10

Increments = 45%, 86%, 89%

**Formula used:**

New value = Original × (1 + increase/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ X = 18 × 145/100 = 26.1

⇒ Y = 5 × 186/100 = 9.3

⇒ Z = 10 × 189/100 = 18.9

⇒ Ratio = 26.1 : 9.3 : 18.9

⇒ Multiply by 10 ⇒ 261 : 93 : 189

⇒ Divide by 3 ⇒ 87 : 31 : 63

**∴ The correct answer is 87 : 31 : 63.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Increase

New value = Original × (1 + percentage/100).

Ratio Transformation

Multiply each term by its respective factor before simplifying.

Simplification Trick

Convert decimals into integers and reduce by common factor.

questions.question: P and Q together can fill a cistern with water in 8 hours. If P alone can fill the cistern with water in 16 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill one-fourth of the same cistern with water?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total capacity = LCM of 8 and 16 = 16 units.

Combined efficiency of P and Q = 16 ÷ 8 = 2 units/hour.

Efficiency of P = 16 ÷ 16 = 1 unit/hour.

Efficiency of Q = 2 − 1 = 1 unit/hour.

Time for Q to fill 1/4th of the cistern = (16 × 1/4) ÷ 1 = 4 ÷ 1 = 4 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by P and Q together to fill the cistern = 8 hours

Time taken by P alone to fill the cistern = 16 hours

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = LCM of given hours

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time taken

Time = Work ÷ Efficiency

 
 

 **Pipe**
 **Hours**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**

**Calculations:**

⇒ Efficiency of Q = Efficiency of (P + Q) − Efficiency of P

⇒ Efficiency of Q = 2 − 1 = 1 unit/hour

⇒ Total work required by Q = 1/4 of the total cistern capacity

⇒ Required Work = 1/4 × 16 = 4 units

⇒ Time taken by Q alone = Required Work ÷ Efficiency of Q

⇒ Time taken by Q alone = 4 ÷ 1 = 4 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 4 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes and Cisterns vs Time & Work

It operates on the exact same logic as regular Time & Work problems. A filling pipe adds positive work, while an emptying pipe or a leak contributes negative work.

Work & Efficiency Relation

Time taken is inversely proportional to efficiency. Therefore, the ratio of time taken by two working entities is exactly the reciprocal of their efficiency ratio.

Partial Work Execution

When asked to calculate time for a fraction of the work, always calculate the complete work (LCM) first, find the required fraction of units, and then divide it by the specific efficiency of the respective person or pipe.
</p

questions.question: A cyclist rides a 180 km course consisting of three segments. For the first 60 km, the cyclist rides at a speed of 20 km/hr. For the next 60 km, the cyclist rides at 30 km/hr. For the final 60 km, the cyclist rides at 60 km/hr. What is the cyclist's average speed for the entire journey?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the cyclist covers three equal distances, assume the length of each segment to be the LCM of the given speeds (20, 30, 60).

⇒ LCM of 20, 30, and 60 = 60 km.

⇒ Time taken for each part = (60÷20) + (60÷30) + (60÷60) = 3 + 2 + 1 = 6 hours.

⇒ Average Speed = Total Assumed Distance ÷ Total Time = (3 × 60) ÷ 6 = 30 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 30 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

questions.question: The average age of 34 students of a class is 29 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 30 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Age of new member = Old Average + (Total new members × Increase in Average)

Old Average = 29 years

Total new members = 34 + 1 = 35

Increase in Average = 30 − 29 = 1 year

Teacher's Age = 29 + (35 × 1) = 64 years

**∴ The correct answer is 64 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average age of 34 students = 29 years

Average age after including the teacher = 30 years

**Formula Used:**

Total Age = Average Age × Number of Persons

 
 
 

 
 
 
 Sum of 34 Students = 34 × 29 = 986
 
 Sum of 35 Persons (with Teacher) = 35 × 30 = 1050
 

 Increase = Teacher's Age = 64

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total age of 34 students = 34 × 29

⇒ Total age of 34 students = 986 years

⇒ Total number of persons = 34 students + 1 teacher = 35

⇒ Total age of 35 persons = 35 × 30

⇒ Total age of 35 persons = 1050 years

⇒ Age of the teacher = Total age of 35 persons − Total age of 34 students

⇒ Age of the teacher = 1050 − 986 = 64 years

**∴ The correct answer is 64 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inclusion of a New Member

If adding a person increases the average of n members by x, the new member's value is: Old Average + (n + 1) × x.

Exclusion of a Member

If a person leaves and the average of the remaining n−1 members drops by y, the departing person's value is: Old Average + (n − 1) × y.

Replacement Method

If a new person replaces an old one and the average increases by z, the new person's value = Replaced person's value + n × z.
</p

questions.question: Which of the following pairs of numbers are relatively prime to each other?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relatively prime numbers have no common factors other than 1.

⇒ (68, 85) are multiples of 17; (102, 153) are multiples of 17; (65, 91) are multiples of 13.

⇒ For (52, 105), 52 = 4 × 13 and 105 = 3 × 5 × 7. They have no common factors.

**∴ The correct answer is (52, 105).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Pairs of numbers: (68, 85), (102, 153), (65, 91), and (52, 105)

**Concept Used:**

Two integers are relatively prime (or coprime) if their Highest Common Factor (HCF) is 1.

**Calculation:**

⇒ 68 = 2² × 17 | 85 = 5 × 17 → HCF = 17

⇒ 102 = 2 × 3 × 17 | 153 = 3² × 17 → HCF = 51

⇒ 65 = 5 × 13 | 91 = 7 × 13 → HCF = 13

⇒ 52 = 2² × 13 | 105 = 3 × 5 × 7 → HCF = 1

⇒ HCF of 52 and 105 is 1, thus they are relatively prime to each other.

**∴ The correct answer is (52, 105).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Coprime Numbers

Two numbers are coprime (or relatively prime) if their Highest Common Factor (HCF) is 1. Coprime numbers do not need to be prime numbers themselves. Example: 8 and 15.

Properties of Coprime Numbers

The sum and product of any two coprime numbers are also coprime to each other. The Lowest Common Multiple (LCM) of two coprime numbers is always equal to their product: LCM(a, b) = a × b.

Twin Primes

Twin primes are specific pairs of prime numbers that have a difference of 2 between them. Examples: (3, 5), (11, 13), and (17, 19).
</p

questions.question: Two pipes A and B fill a tank in 32 and 36 minutes, respectively and pipe C empties 13 cubic units per minute. All three pipes together can fill the tank in 20 minutes. Find the capacity (in cubic units) of the tank.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM of times (32, 36, 20) = 1440 units.

Efficiencies: A = 1440 ÷ 32 = 45, B = 1440 ÷ 36 = 40, and (A + B + C) = 1440 ÷ 20 = 72 units/min.

Efficiency of C = 72 − (45 + 40) = −13 units/min (emptying).

Given C empties 13 cubic units/min, so 13 work units = 13 cubic units ⇒ 1 work unit = 1 cubic unit.

**∴ The correct answer is 1440 cubic units.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by Pipe A = 32 minutes

Time taken by Pipe B = 36 minutes

Time taken by Pipes A, B, and C together = 20 minutes

Emptying rate of Pipe C = 13 cubic units/min

 
 

 **Pipe**
 **Time (minutes)**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 A
 32
 1440
 45
 
 

 B
 36
 40
 
 

 A + B + C
 20

⇒ Combined efficiency of A and B = 45 + 40 = 85 units/min

⇒ Efficiency of C = Combined Efficiency − Efficiency of (A + B)

⇒ Efficiency of C = 72 − 85 = −13 units/min

⇒ The negative sign indicates that Pipe C is an emptying pipe.

⇒ Pipe C empties 13 units of work per minute.

⇒ We are given that Pipe C empties 13 cubic units per minute.

⇒ Therefore, 13 units = 13 cubic units ⇒ 1 unit = 1 cubic unit.

⇒ Total capacity of the tank = 1440 units × 1 cubic unit/unit = 1440 cubic units.

**∴ The correct answer is 1440 cubic units.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes and Cisterns

The logic for pipes and cisterns is identical to time and work. An inlet pipe does positive work while an outlet pipe does negative work.

Negative Work

If an outlet pipe empties a full tank in *y* minutes, its 1 minute's work is −1/*y*.

Tank Capacity Formula

Capacity of a tank = Total time taken by the emptying pipe to empty the full tank × Volume emptied per unit time.

questions.question: Simplify: (x + 2)² - (x - 3)²
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the algebraic identity: a² − b² = (a + b)(a − b)

Let a = x + 2 and b = x − 3

Sum (a + b) = (x + 2) + (x − 3) = 2x − 1

Difference (a − b) = (x + 2) − (x − 3) = 5

Product = 5 × (2x − 1) = 10x − 5

**∴ The correct answer is 10x − 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: (x + 2)² − (x − 3)²

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²

(a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Expand the first binomial square: (x + 2)² = x² + 4x + 4

⇒ Expand the second binomial square: (x − 3)² = x² − 6x + 9

⇒ Substitute the expanded forms back into the expression: (x² + 4x + 4) − (x² − 6x + 9)

⇒ Open the brackets by distributing the negative sign: x² + 4x + 4 − x² + 6x − 9

⇒ Group the like terms together for simplification: (x² − x²) + (4x + 6x) + (4 − 9)

⇒ Calculate the final simplified expression: 10x − 5

**∴ The correct answer is 10x − 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference of Two Squares

The identity a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b) is highly useful to quickly simplify algebraic expressions without expanding terms fully.

Square of a Binomial

The identities (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b² and (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b² are fundamental rules in polynomial expansion.

BODMAS Rule in Algebra

Always apply operations in order: process Brackets first, then Orders (exponents), followed by simplifying remaining Addition and Subtraction of like terms.

questions.question: If the price of rice increases by 20% and a person reduces its consumption by 20%, by what percentage will his total expenditure on rice decrease?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When two quantities are multiplied (like Expenditure = Price × Consumption) and one increases by x% while the other decreases by x%, the net change is always a decrease.

Formula for Net Decrease % = (x² ÷ 100)%

Given x = 20%

Net Decrease % = (20² ÷ 100)% = (400 ÷ 100)% = 4%

**∴ The correct answer is 4%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 Initial State
 Price: 100
 Cons: 100
 Exp: 10000

 
 Final State
 Price: 120 (+20%)
 Cons: 80 (−20%)
 Exp: 9600

 
• 
 4% Decrease

 Change in Exp = 10000 → 9600

**Given:**

Price increase = 20%

Consumption decrease = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Expenditure = Price × Consumption

Percentage Change = (Change in Value ÷ Original Value) × 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the initial price of rice be 100 and initial consumption be 100.

⇒ Initial Expenditure = 100 × 100 = 10,000

⇒ New Price = 100 + 20% of 100 = 120

⇒ New Consumption = 100 − 20% of 100 = 80

⇒ New Expenditure = 120 × 80 = 9,600

⇒ Decrease in Expenditure = 10,000 − 9,600 = 400

⇒ Percentage Decrease = (400 ÷ 10,000) × 100 = 4%

**∴ The correct answer is 4%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Formula

When a value undergoes two successive changes of a% and b%, the net percentage change is given by: Net Change = a + b + (a × b)/100. Use positive signs for increments and negative for decrements.

Equal Increment and Decrement Rule

If a number is first increased by x% and then decreased by x%, or vice-versa, there is always an overall decrease. The percentage decrease is directly calculated as (x² ÷ 100)%.

Constant Expenditure Relation

If the total expenditure on an item must remain constant, the Price and Consumption are inversely proportional to each other. An increase in price by (a/b) leads to a mandatory decrease in consumption by a/(a+b).

questions.question: The present age of a father is two times the age of his son. Fifteen years ago from now, the father was three times as old as his son was at that time. Find the present age of the father.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

⇒ Let son's age = x → father = 2x

⇒ 15 years ago: 2x − 15 = 3(x − 15)

⇒ Solve → 2x − 15 = 3x − 45 → x = 30

⇒ Father = 2x = 60

**∴ Answer = 60 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Father’s present age = 2 × son’s age

⇒ 15 years ago: father was 3 times son

**Formula:**

⇒ Age relation: Present ± years

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let son’s present age = x

⇒ Father’s present age = 2x

⇒ 15 years ago:

⇒ Father = 2x − 15

⇒ Son = x − 15

⇒ According to condition:

⇒ 2x − 15 = 3(x − 15)

⇒ 2x − 15 = 3x − 45

⇒ x = 30

⇒ Father’s age = 2x = 60

**∴ Final Answer: 60 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**1. Age Problems:** Assume variable for present age

**2. Past Age:** Subtract years

**3. Equation Form:** Use given relation

**4. Tip:** Always check logical consistency

questions.question: The amount on a sum of ₹3,500 at 20% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective compound interest rate for 2 years at 20% = 20 + 20 + (20 × 20) ÷ 100 = 44%

Total amount after 2 years = 100% (Principal) + 44% (Interest) = 144%

Amount = 144% of 3500 = 1.44 × 3500 = 5040

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5,040.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹3,500

Rate (R) = 20% per annum

Time (n) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ

 
 
• 
 + 20% 
 + 20% Start (Year 0) ₹3,500 Year 1 ₹4,200 Year 2 A = ? 

**Calculation:**

⇒ A = 3500 × (1 + 20/100)²

⇒ A = 3500 × (1 + 1/5)²

⇒ A = 3500 × (6/5) × (6/5)

⇒ A = 3500 × 36 ÷ 25

⇒ A = 140 × 36

⇒ A = 5040

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5,040.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate of Compound Interest

For 2 years, the effective compound interest rate can be found using the successive percentage formula: Rₑff = 2R + (R² ÷ 100)%.

Difference Between CI and SI for 2 Years

The difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest on a certain sum for exactly 2 years is calculated directly as: D = P × (R ÷ 100)².

Half-Yearly Compounding

When interest is compounded half-yearly, the annual rate becomes half (R ÷ 2) and the time periods are doubled (2n).
